jobs.title: Remote Project Manager - Energy and Mobility Solutions
jobs.description:
Description

Project Manager - Energy and Mobility Solutions

Remote - (Travel Required)

TechFlow seeks to hire Project Managers to support our growing Energy and Mobility Solutions Business Unit. The Project Managers will work across functions to support Energy and Mobility projects within the Business Unit. The Project Managers will also provide leadership and direction to project teams and will be responsible for planning, delivery, management, and oversite of assigned projects.

Responsibilities

Coordinate teams of internal and external resources to manage and deliver projects safely, on time, within budget and to required specifications.

Participate in the development of project scope, cost estimates, schedules, designs, and delivery solutions.

Coordinate pre-construction meetings.

Provide accurate and timely project status reporting addressing milestone progress, risk management, current and forecast financial performance.

Perform in person site visits to project site(s) as needed.

Participate in project progress meetings with client, general contractor, subcontractors, vendors, and Business Unit Vice President.

Ensure predictable and unexpected complexities are effectively monitored, mitigated and communicated timely to the Business Unit Vice President.

Manage dependencies, risks, schedule, costs and resourcing for each project and across interlinked projects in coordination with Business Unit Vice President.

Requirements

High school diploma or equivalent, with relevant technical training, education, or experience in electrical construction or a related industry.

Minimum of three years of experience supporting or managing electrical construction projects, related to energy infrastructure and technology

Experience evaluating costs and scope of work requirements for electrical construction projects.

Ability to manage multiple large projects.

Must possess interpersonal and influencing skills to engage and work alongside other TechFlow employees and team members to drive performance improvements.

Strong presentation and written communication skills.

Excellent organizational and decision making/problem solving skills.

Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments.

Ability to travel up to 60% of the time.

Eligibility to obtain and sustain DOD Secret level Security Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Certified project management professional (PMP)

Proficiency in associated project management tools to track schedule, budgets, and approvals

Experience providing support to Federal Government clients

#techflow

Benefits

About TechFlow

Founded in 1995 at the start of the dot-com revolution, TechFlow helped large commercial clients such as Dreamworks, Toshiba, MGM, and others modernize their business systems. Today, with deep operational roots in the bi-coastal innovation hubs of California and Washington DC, TechFlow continues as a leader in applying innovative engineering, technology, integration solutions, and support services to the Federal Government’s most demanding mission and business challenges.

Our culture thrives on out-of-the-box thinking and the unique powerful entrepreneurial expressions of our employee-owners. As a 100% employee-owned company, we have a shared expectation of commitment, accountability, and responsibility driven by a culture that embraces innovation and new ideas. Our goal is not to do what has been done, but to do it better.

TechFlow has four principal lines of business: Platform Services, Mission Services, Digital Services and Energy & Mobility Solutions. Our company has a strong track record of successful contracts in both areas and encourages cross-collaboration.

Benefits

TechFlow, Inc is 100% employee-owned. Come make a difference in a job that contributes to your future and helps us build an agile workplace!

jobs.title: Business Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Business Project Managers
to support cross-functional teams and ensure seamless execution of project workflows using Azure DevOps.
This role is pivotal in driving team alignment, maintaining visibility into progress, and fostering consistent project management practices. The ideal candidate is a natural collaborator with strong communication skills, capable of facilitating stand-ups and meetings, identifying blockers, and keeping stakeholders informed through clear reporting. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about enabling teams to deliver high-quality work on time, we’d love to meet you.

This position is a night shift work-from-home position with a usual schedule of 9am EST - 6pm EST.

Responsibilities
(include but are not limited to the following):
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and department-specific task boards using Azure DevOps
Coordinate tasks and resources across multiple teams to ensure alignment with goals and deadlines
Support development teams by facilitating stand-ups, meetings, and follow-ups
Serve as a key point of contact for internal teams, maintaining smooth communication and progress tracking
Ensure team boards are up to date and clearly reflect current priorities and status
Assist in planning, deployment, and handover of completed work, including documentation and scheduling
Help identify risks, delays, and blockers, and work with leaders to resolve them
Prepare simple reports and updates for management on team/project progress
Champion consistency in work management practices and drive team collaboration
Guide teams in applying basic Agile principles to improve workflow and delivery

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, IT, Legal Studies, or related field—or equivalent experience
Minimum 4 years of experience in project management

Familiarity with project management tools, particularly Azure DevOps
, as well as others like Jira, Trello, or similar task boards
Strong organizational and communication skills with a detail-oriented mindset
Proficient in English (spoken and written) / Very Strong Communication
(American accent is a plus)
Comfortable working full-time on a night shift schedule
Able to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced setting
Knowledge of Agile or Scrum frameworks

Background supporting US-based clients or distributed teams
High Ownership; Cross-functional Technical Fluency; Experience Risk Management Practices and Operating in Fast-Paced Environments

Nice-to-Have:

Previous experience working on a night shift and remote setup
Has experience coordinating and delivering key cross-functional business initiatives at a high-level of impact and ownership
Scrum Master or PMP-related certification/training

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Software Development)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Technical Project Manager (Software Development)

Location: Bogotá, Colombia (Remote)

Experience Level: 2 to 5 Years

Employment Type: Full Time

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to lead the planning and delivery of our software projects. You will be the bridge between our US leadership and our engineering team, working closely with Full Stack, .NET, and QA engineers on an enterprise platform for HR, staffing, and financial operations, including the modernization of legacy applications into a modern cloud architecture.

Responsibilities

Plan, coordinate, and track software projects from requirements gathering through release.
Run Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, and retrospectives.
Translate business needs from US stakeholders into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and priorities.
Maintain and prioritize the product backlog with leadership and engineering.
Manage timelines, scope, dependencies, and risks across multiple projects.
Coordinate with QA to ensure releases meet quality standards.
Support the migration from legacy .NET applications to a Node.js and TypeScript architecture on AWS.
Remove blockers and escalate issues early when they affect delivery.
Report project status and risks to US leadership clearly, both written and verbally.
Keep project documentation, roadmaps, and release notes up to date.

Required Skills

2 to 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, Technical Project Manager, or Scrum Master in software development.
Advanced or fluent English (C1 or higher), with the ability to lead meetings and write clear documentation for US based stakeholders.

Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
Hands on experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, or similar.
Enough technical background to discuss web applications, REST APIs, databases, and cloud environments with engineers.
Experience managing Full Stack, Backend, and QA engineers.
Strong organization, prioritization, and communication skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience working with US companies or US based clients, ideally in a nearshore or remote model.
Familiarity with React, TypeScript, Node.js/NestJS, C#/.NET, SQL Server, MongoDB, and AWS.
Experience with legacy system modernization or migration projects.
Background in SaaS products, especially HR tech, staffing, payroll, or fintech.
Certifications such as PMP, CAPM, PSM, CSM, or similar.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

jobs.title: Remote AWS Project Manager
jobs.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part Of Accenture

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

We are hiring for an AWS Project Manager to work with our Mid-Market & Enterprise customers! As the Project Manager, you will manage projects by providing day-to-day leadership to analyze their requirements, developing designs, and implementing cloud-based contact center solutions based on Amazon Connect and the broader AWS ecosystem.

The ideal candidate has experience working with small and large customers and is comfortable with playing multiple roles on an engagement to be successful. The Project Manager is professional and confident in front of VP and Director-level stakeholders, has a strong analytical and consultative mindset, and thrives when working against tight deadlines. If you appreciate working with cutting edge technology and delivering exciting new digital solutions - then this is the role for you!

You'll Have The Opportunity To

Plan, initiate, and lead the full lifecycle delivery of contact center (CCaaS), conversational AI, and agentic solutions and migrations

Monitor and manage project financials, scope and change control, schedule, dependencies, milestones, and risks

Facilitate regular status meetings with the project team, sponsors, and all stakeholders, and publish weekly status reports that proactively communicate progress, early risk indicators, and forward-looking milestones

Act as the client’s primary day-to-day point of contact, with a focus on building strong customer relationships

Lead client-facing Outcomes and Business Objectives sessions at project kickoff, defining success metrics and desired business outcomes, then track and report progress against them throughout the engagement

Establish client and project team roles, decision rights, and dependencies at kickoff, and drive timely client decisions and stakeholder access throughout the engagement

Partner with the Solution & Technical Architects to capture, groom, and trace business requirements and user stories through design specifications and delivery, owning the quality of user stories and acceptance criteria

Assist consultant team members in the delivery of client presentations during requirements, design, pilot and user acceptance testing sessions

Facilitate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including coordinating test plans, tracking defects, and driving resolution with the project team

Support end-user training by coordinating logistics, contributing to materials, and ensuring client readiness

Plan and coordinate production cutover and post-go-live hypercare activities

Coordinate across distributed customer and delivery teams, including AWS teams, third-party vendors, architects, developers, QA, and DevOps, to manage dependencies

Serve as Agile Scrum Master and guide the software development lifecycle (SDLC) process

Apply AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery, within approved tools and client data-handling requirements

Required Qualifications

5+ years of project management experience in contact center environments, including Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) implementations

2+ years of hands-on experience as project manager or scrum leader on Amazon Connect implementations

AI delivery/solution experience in a contact center context, specifically overseeing blueprint and implementation projects

Experience working in a professional services/consulting environment

Experience with estimation/sizing and SOW/Change Order contracting

Demonstrated experience facilitating requirements sessions, writing or grooming user stories, and presenting functional content directly to client stakeholders

Experience applying Agile and hybrid approaches to project management

Current AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) certification

Preferred Skills

Working knowledge of contact center technology, including IVR and voice, chat, and SMS channels, call routing, integrations, and reporting

Hands-on experience delivering agentic AI solutions in a contact center context

Hands-on experience with Jira and Smartsheet, or similar project-management and agile tooling

A hybrid skillset; prior experience in roles such as Solution Architect, Product Owner, Functional/Technical Consultant, or Business Analyst

Strong presentation and communication skills

Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve project delivery

Ability to influence without formal authority, resolve conflict, and drive decisions across client and delivery teams

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology or Management

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.

Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.

Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done

Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.

Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

jobs.description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY’s solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies.

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today’s data-rich world.

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy.

Job Description

Sr. Project Managers at ELLKAY are accountable for driving the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional projects across the ELLKAY product suite, ensuring high-quality outcomes that support healthcare clients’ evolving needs. This role combines hands-on project leadership with people development and process improvement. In addition to directly managing high-priority client implementations, Sr. PMs serve as mentors and escalation points for other project managers, helping to continuously elevate the performance and impact of the broader delivery team.

Ideal candidates bring deep experience in healthcare technology, exceptional organizational and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence both internal and client teams. The Sr. PM ensures delivery excellence, cultivates strong client relationships, and drives innovation in implementation practices and team operations.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Project Delivery Leadership

Oversee the successful implementation of ELLKAY’ssolutions in the ELLKAY product suite.  
Oversee full lifecycle implementation of complex healthcare data, interoperability, or migration projects, includingplanning, execution, and deployment across multiple ELLKAY product lines.
Lead high-impact client engagements that require advanced technical knowledge, cross-department coordination, and strategic stakeholder alignment.
Own project planning and execution: create detailed project plans, manage resource allocation, track milestones, and ensure on-time, in-scope delivery.
Serve as the primary point of contact for project communications and status updates with internal and external stakeholders, including executive sponsors.
Manage and resolve risks, issues,scopechanges, andinterdependenciesacross technology, business, and client functions.
Define and enforce success criteria across projects; ensure high client satisfaction and alignment with contractual deliverables.

People Leadership & Team Development

Provide coaching, mentorship, and operational support to project managers and junior staff within the department.
Serve as the first point of escalation for project and client issues that require elevated attention.
Contribute to onboarding, training, and knowledge transfer across the project management team.
Foster a high-performance team culture that emphasizes collaboration, quality, and ownership.

Process & Strategic Improvement

Identifyand champion opportunities tooptimizedelivery methodologies, tools, and workflows.
Recommend and help implement improvements to team processes, documentation standards, and project reporting frameworks.
Contribute to internal strategic initiatives aimed at improving client outcomes, scalability, and efficiency.
Participate in department-wide planning and alignment efforts with Product, Engineering, QA, and Sales teams.

Qualifications

Experience in client-facing roles with a service-oriented mindset andhigh standardsfor customer experience.
Proven ability to manage and deliver complex, cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience coaching and mentoring project managers or junior team members.
Advanced organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.
Strategic problem solver with strong critical thinking, issue resolution, and decision-making skills.
Confident and collaborative team player who thrives in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.
Experience serving as a primary point of contact for high-stakes clients and navigating sensitive escalations with poise and professionalism.
Demonstrated success building trusted client relationships and aligning project delivery with broader business goals.
Proactive mindset with the ability toidentifyprocess improvement opportunities and drive change within a growing organization.
Strong understanding of EMR systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech),ancillarysystems, or otherclinicaldata platforms.
Proficiencywith healthcare data exchange standards and formats (e.g., HL7, FHIR, CCD, APIs, CSV, XML).
Familiarity with interoperability workflows and integration patterns between healthcare systems.
Working knowledge of networking protocols and data transmission methods (e.g., SFTP, VPN, TCP/IP).
Comfortable leading technical conversations and collaborating with engineering, QA, and product teams.

Education/Training/Experience: 

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, technology, business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of project management experience, with 2+ years in a senior-level or lead role.
Experience delivering implementations within healthcare IT or health data environmentsrequired.
Demonstrated success leading projects across multiple departments or product lines simultaneously.
PMP or other project management certificationstronglypreferred.
Proficiencywith project management and collaboration tools (e.g., MSOffice Suite, Asana,Vision,Jira, Confluence).

ELLKAY is committed to fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment that supports innovation, teamwork, and professional growth. Most roles are designed to operate from our office locations to encourage effective collaboration and engagement across teams.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Project Manager

Department

South Central Studio

Reports To

Team Lead - Project Manager

Flsa Status

Exempt

Job Type

Full time

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $75,000 - $80,000 annually, plus bonus eligibility. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and geographic market considerations.

LOCATION:

Houston, TX (Remote) We offer the flexibility of a remote work environment, but we are specifically seeking candidates

who reside in or around Houston, TX

for local market alignment and regional support needs.

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday June 5, 2026

CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY

At Meteor, integrity and transparency are paramount in all our operations and interactions. To avoid any potential conflicts of interest and maintain the trust of our public customers, we regret that we cannot consider applications from individuals who are currently employed by organizations that are customers of Meteor, where they hold positions that could influence the purchasing decisions regarding our products or services. This policy ensures fairness and impartiality in our hiring process and customer interactions.

If you fall under this category, we appreciate your understanding and encourage your continued support as a valued customer.

Summary Of Position

The Project Manager (PM) owns the fulfillment of assigned projects, exceeding the expectations of the customer, and ensuring profit protection. This involves managing the order process of educational fixtures and furniture for our clients through order entry, delivery scheduling, installation coordination, onsite project management and punch list processing. The candidate will lead through influence as well as detailed planning, coordination and communication with customers, vendors, installers, and the Studio team. The PM oversees all tasks, critical dates, client, and third-party interface Insights customer portal, client relations, performance quality, budget, and project administration for each assigned project.

Essential Responsibilities

Project Planning, Coordination and Management

Attends project meetings as required to establish overall project scope in concert with Studio Team and manage project from purchase order through completion.

Works collaboratively with Studio Team to deliver exceptional customer journey.

Directs, coordinates, and manages tasks, assignments, and completion for entire studio and project team.

Coordinates with studio team to develop work plans, schedule, and logistics based on overall project parameters, project schedule and scope, and customer’s goals.

Reviews project site, plans, and product specifications.

Works with the Studio team of designers and Project Coordinators to ensure complete turnover of all project information including but not limited to plans, notes, room door lists, notes following the receipt of purchase order.

Acts as a single point of contact for client and suppliers.

Communicates proactively and effectively with customers and provides detailed project updates.

Project Administration

Maintains detailed project documentation of key project decisions including customer requests and revisions.

Provides timely, formal written communications throughout project to client, third parties, and Meteor project team.

Manages accurate and detailed record keeping including receiving documentation, time sheets and contract adherence, sign-offs and approvals, and key decision records.

Maintains Insights in concert with Learning Environment Specialist to ensure current and accurate information is represented to the customer during and following project installation.

Project/Installation Implementation

Coordinates with Studio Project Coordinator (PC )and Learning Environment Specialist (Sales) under standardized practice through the Best Practice Leader in planning, scheduling, and managing installations and third-party installation companies.

Works collaboratively with Studio Team to deliver exceptional customer journey.

Performs on-site leadership, strategic site visits, and attends walk-throughs as required.

Supervises site furniture and fixture installation including performance of work, installation administration, and timeliness of task completion.

Keeps current with ERP database, all acknowledgments and estimated delivery dates, engaging in continuous follow-up, and expediting with freight suppliers and factories.

Manages and provides instruction to Meteor logistics team regarding coordination of freight costs and meeting delivery schedule.

Reviews open projects and Unbooked Sales Report on a weekly basis ensuring all forecasted dates are current.

Ensures all proof of delivery documents and field paperwork are submitted in a timely manner.

Frequent and/or overnight travel is required for this position.

Punch and Project Close-Out

Performs project walk-through and is responsible for developing punch list with the third-party installer and punch list resolution.

Confirms project completion.

Manages all final project close-out requirements including contract requirements and client signoffs.

Coordinates with billing and ensures timely submission of invoices.

Information Technology (IT) Requirements

Must be proficient in MS Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).

Must be proficient in Salesforce software

Must attend training within the first 30 days of employment and develop proficiency with

Meteor-specific software including Insights Customer Portal and ERP.

College Degree, Or Work Experience Equivalent Is Required.

An MVR check is required. Must possess a valid driver’s license and a reliable vehicle.

Strong knowledge of all aspects of project management including account management, order management, installation, relocation, and project administration.

Project Management accreditation a plus, PMP.

Exceptional customer service skills and ability to effectively lead and manage third parties.

Excellent written and communication skills.

Proven ability to multi-task while managing timelines and deadlines.

Ability to think critically, make quick decisions, and problem solve.

Strong attention to detail.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties, and responsibilities.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. Safety equipment must be worn on job sites as required. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. The work hours for this position vary by client needs and may occasionally require working holidays and/or weekends.

ORIENTATION

All Meteor new hires are expected to attend an in-person cultural orientation, which typically takes place 3 to 6 weeks after their start date and requires travel to our home office in Gainesville, FL. This one-week experience is focused on company culture, values, and connection across teams and is separate from role-specific job training. Employees may also be asked to travel for annual company meetings or other business events. All required business travel expenses are covered by Meteor in accordance with our travel and expense policy.

Basic Life AD&D (100% employer paid)

Flexible Spending Account

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Technical Project Manager / Support Lead -Remote (Canada)
jobs.description:
Role- SAP BRIM Technical Project Manager / Support Lead

Location- Remote (Canada)

Long-Term Contract

Job Description:-

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Project Manager / Support Lead to manage our production support, continuous enhancement, and operational governance across the SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) landscape. This role combines hands-on functional understanding of core BRIM pillars with project management discipline. You will lead a blended onshore/offshore team, enforce ITIL-based SLA/KPI targets, drive critical incident resolution, and govern small-to-medium business enhancements from scoping to hypercare.

Key Responsibilities

Support Operations & SLA Governance

Lead day-to-day operations for Level 2 and Level 3 production support across the entire SAP BRIM suite.
Own and report operational KPIs: mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), SLA compliance (>98%), ticket backlog trends, and first-time-fix rates.
Serve as the primary escalation point for Priority 1/2 billing, mediation, rating, and invoicing incidents; lead root cause analyses (RCA) and post-mortem discussions.
Manage high-volume recurring operations: month-end billing cycles, automated rating batches, bill-run failures, out-of-sequence consumption data, and financial posting reconciliations.

Project Management & Continuous Improvement

Manage minor release cadences, change requests (CRs), and platform enhancements using hybrid Agile/Scrum or Waterfall frameworks.
Own project schedules, resource allocations, sprint backlogs, risk/issues/assumptions/dependencies (RAID) logs, and release readiness checklists.
Coordinate end-to-end delivery: requirement discovery, solution design review, build, system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization.
Interface directly with business finance, IT steering committees, external System Integrators (SIs), and vendor partners.

Functional Oversight & Solution Integrity

Provide functional governance across core modules:

SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management): Subscription lifecycle, master agreements, product catalog, provider contracts.
SAP CC (Convergent Charging): Rating and charging logic, charge plans, allowance logic, subscriber mapping.
SAP CI (Convergent Invoicing): Billable items (BITs), consumption items (CITs), bill runs, aggregation, invoicing rules.
SAP RAR: Revenue postings, reconciliation & rev-rec.
Coordinate integration integrity with SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP CPQ, SAP Integration Suite (CPI), external CRM, and data mediation layers.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Total Experience:
8+ years of IT delivery/support experience, with at least 4+ years dedicated to SAP BRIM (formerly Hybris Billing) and 3+ years running project management or application maintenance services (AMS).
Core Technical Expertise:
Functional or technical depth in at least two of the four BRIM components (SOM, CC, CI, RAR) alongside familiarity with the overall end-to-end data pipeline.
Support Frameworks:
Proven experience running structured ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management) using tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or SAP Solution Manager.
Project Delivery:
Demonstrated success managing cross-functional technical teams (developers, functional consultants, BASIS, middleware teams) across distributed time zones.
Integration Acumen:
Familiarity with modern SAP interface technologies (OData, REST APIs, IDocs, SAP CPI) and reconciliation between rated events and general ledger entries.
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.

Overview

Our client is integrating recently acquired companies into its export controls program. The U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) controls specific items and technologies for export and technology transfers across borders. This project spans two to three business units. The Project Manager will lead implementation of the internal controls needed to manage export controls for the recent acquisitions, from planning through documented, operational completion.

Export control and technical subject matter experts (SMEs) will provide the regulatory and technical content. The Project Manager’s focus is driving progress: tracking delivery, identifying delays and roadblocks early, and finding solutions to keep work moving.

The Four Workstreams

1. Export controls: install and improve controls to detect and identify the controlled items.

2. Technology transfer controls: create and implement controls over transfers of controlled technology.

3. Deemed export controls: expand and improve controls over release of controlled technology to foreign persons.

4. Training: enhance existing training and create new training for affected audiences.

Responsibilities

Plan: build a comprehensive integrated project plan across all four workstreams, with milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.
Track and unblock: monitor progress against the plan, identify delays and risks, and drive solutions, escalating to leadership when needed.
Report: create and maintain a project dashboard, and deliver weekly and monthly metrics and status reports.
Coordinate: schedule and facilitate cross-functional meetings and training sessions with business units, export control SMEs, and technical SMEs.
Document: write and edit SOPs and job aids from SME input, and maintain project records of decisions, approvals, and control implementation.
Work efficiently: use AI tools to speed drafting, summarizing, analysis, and reporting, with review for accuracy and compliance with company policy.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Help Build the Future of Caterpillar

At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. By combining deep domain expertise in physical systems with software, connectivity, autonomy, and AI, we deliver solutions that work in the real world—on real jobsites, at global scale.

You’ll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations—over 1.6 million connected assets generating real-world data daily. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale.

Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.

Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.

If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.

Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.

Serve as the primary escalation point for Priority 1/2 billing, mediation, rating, and invoicing incidents; lead root cause analyses (RCA) and post-mortem discussions.
Manage high-volume recurring operations: month-end billing cycles, automated rating batches, bill-run failures, out-of-sequence consumption data, and financial posting reconciliations.

SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management): Subscription lifecycle, master agreements, product catalog, provider contracts.
SAP CC (Convergent Charging): Rating and charging logic, charge plans, allowance logic, subscriber mapping.

Integration Acumen: Familiarity with modern SAP interface technologies (OData, REST APIs, IDocs, SAP CPI) and reconciliation between rated events and general ledger entries.

This multi-year program is designed to address immediate passenger growth demands while preparing Canada’s largest airport for the future of air travel—including critical upgrades to airfield and infrastructure, greenhouse gas reduction initiatives, modernization of Terminals 1 and 3, and the creation of a world-class passenger experience.

JOB SUMMARY

The Security Manager is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and execution of security measures across construction activities. Working closely with Senior Project Manager -Logistics & Security, Logistics Manager, Central Logistics Hub Manager, Sub-Program Leads, Site Superintendents, Security Coordinators, PACT stakeholders, and the GTAA, this role ensures that all security requirements are properly integrated into project work, aligned with the PACT Construction Security Management Plan (CSMP), Construction Management Plan, Logistics, Strategy and Management Plan, Construction Safety Management Plan (CSMP), and compliant with regulatory and airport standards. The Security Manager will also support the development of Access Control Plans, Video Surveillance Systems, Timelapse CCTV Systems, manage stakeholder communications, monitor security performance, and drive continuous improvement in site security and access control practices.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead the development, coordination, and implementation of Project Specific Security Plans in collaboration with other Security Managers, Coordinators, and PACT H&S, Environmental, and Construction teams.
• Ensure all plans align with the PACT CSMP, logistics strategies, risk registers, and other program requirements.
• Prepare and submit security plans to the GTAA for review and comment prior to implementation.
• Support the development of Access Control Plans including:
o Turnstiles, guard booths, parking gates
o Entry/exit points and site security checkpoints
o CCTV placement/monitoring strategies
o Security guard deployment
o RFID credentialing systems and temporary pass processes
o Modifications to PSL lines or airport security infrastructure
• Oversee client-leased equipment for issuing temporary passes to non-RAIC workers and visitors.
• Evaluate and support integration of advanced access control technologies, including iLobby FacilityOS (mobile sign-in/out, visitor management, sensors, RFID tracking, asset management, compliance reporting).
• Facilitate recurring security meetings as required.
• Lead discussions on construction access requirements, schedules, security impacts, operational changes, and permitting.
• Collaborate with GTAA representatives to identify security risks and propose mitigation strategies.
• Maintain detailed records of meetings, action items, and follow-ups.
• Conduct routine audits of security protocols to verify compliance with GTAA requirements, regulatory standards, and PACT program expectations.
• Review audit results, incident reports, and stakeholder feedback to drive continuous improvement.
• Ensure corrective actions are documented, monitored, and resolved in a timely manner.
• Perform scheduled and ad hoc security inspections across construction sites and provide recommendations to strengthen security performance.
• Investigate, identify, and develop opportunities for innovation within security systems, supporting PACT‑wide initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, digital integration, and continuous improvement across the program.

WORKING CONDITIONS

The position will be based at our office in Mississauga, Ontario, with regular visits to the Airport site as required. The role may transition to be based at the project site. This position is 5 days
per week with core hours of work between approximately 8:00am-5:00pm, as well as additional hours as needed. All employees must complete the RAIC (Restricted Area Identification Card) process and a Criminal background check upon joining the company.

DESIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, COMPETENCIES

• Diploma or degree in Construction Management, Security Management, Civil Engineering, or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in security operations and project management for large infrastructure or aviation projects.
• Strong understanding of access control systems, construction logistics, and regulatory compliance.
• Proficiency with digital security platforms, credentialing systems, and reporting tools.
• Experience coordinating with airport authorities, security teams, and multiple contractors is preferred.
• Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Familiarity with GTAA or other major airport procedures is considered an asset.
• Valid driver’s license and eligibility for RAIC clearance required.

The Opportunity

Skyline Recruitment is partnering with an established and respected environmental consulting firm in Mississauga to recruit a Project Manager specializing in Hazardous Materials and/or Occupational Hygiene
.

This is an excellent opportunity for an intermediate-level environmental professional looking to take greater ownership of projects, develop client relationships and continue advancing their career within a collaborative technical consulting environment.

We're particularly interested in individuals with experience in hazardous building materials, asbestos, designated substances, mould investigations, indoor air quality or occupational hygiene.

You do not need experience across every discipline.
Candidates with a strong background in either hazardous materials or occupational hygiene are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Manage environmental consulting projects from initial planning and proposals through fieldwork, reporting and completion.
Coordinate hazardous materials assessments, designated substances surveys, mould investigations and/or occupational hygiene assignments.
Oversee project budgets, schedules, resources and technical deliverables.
Prepare and review technical reports, proposals and recommendations for clients.
Coordinate field technicians, consultants, subcontractors and other project stakeholders.
Maintain strong client relationships and ensure projects are delivered to a high technical standard.

Ensure work is completed in accordance with applicable Ontario regulations, industry standards and health and safety requirements.

in environmental consulting, hazardous materials, occupational hygiene or related disciplines.
Previous project management or project coordination experience, including responsibility for budgets, scheduling, technical deliverables or client relationships.
Practical experience in at least one of the following:
Asbestos, lead, designated substances and hazardous building materials assessments.
Occupational hygiene, exposure assessments and workplace monitoring.
Indoor air quality, mould investigations and remediation oversight.
Strong organizational, communication and technical reporting skills.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and coordinate with clients and field personnel.
Relevant post-secondary education in environmental science, occupational health and safety, engineering or a related field is preferred.

Candidates currently working as Project Coordinators, Project Technologists or Environmental Consultants who are ready to transition into a Project Manager position are also encouraged to apply.

Competitive base salary of approximately $75,000–$100,000
, depending on experience.
Permanent opportunity with an established environmental consulting business.
Exposure to diverse hazardous materials and occupational hygiene projects.
Opportunities for technical development, client engagement and increased project ownership.
A supportive environment where you can continue developing your project management career.

jobs.title: Project Manager TI
jobs.description:
EL EQUIPO
El equipo de Soporte e Infraestructura conecta las necesidades del negocio con Tecnología y coordina iniciativas de mantenimiento, mejora, integración e implementación de hardware, software e infraestructura. Trabaja con áreas usuarias, equipos técnicos, grupos globales y proveedores para asegurar continuidad operativa, adopción y generación de valor.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO
La posición de Project Manager TI actúa como enlace entre las áreas de negocio y Tecnología. Comprende necesidades, traduce prioridades en iniciativas viables y coordina proyectos de mantenimiento, mejora, integración e implementación, asegurando claridad en alcance, entregables, responsables y criterios de aceptación.

El rol articula a equipos internos, globales y proveedores para gestionar cronogramas, riesgos, presupuesto aprobado, pruebas, liberaciones, adopción y transición a la operación. También da seguimiento a incidentes críticos y al valor entregado, facilitando decisiones oportunas y una ejecución trazable alineada con las prioridades de la empresa.

LO QUE HARÁS
Actuar como punto de enlace entre las áreas de negocio y Tecnología para identificar necesidades, oportunidades y prioridades.
Traducir requerimientos y puntos de dolor del negocio en iniciativas tecnológicas claras, viables y alineadas con las prioridades de la organización.
Coordinar proyectos de mantenimiento, mejora, integración e implementación de redes e infraestructura desde la definición del alcance hasta el cierre.
Definir y dar seguimiento a entregables, responsables, dependencias, cronogramas, riesgos y criterios de aceptación.
Gestionar expectativas y comunicación con stakeholders internos, Corporate IT, equipos globales y proveedores, facilitando acuerdos y decisiones oportunas.
Administrar la demanda y el portafolio básico de iniciativas asignadas, considerando valor esperado, urgencia, esfuerzo, dependencias y capacidad disponible.
Monitorear alcance, cronograma, calidad, presupuesto aprobado, beneficios y satisfacción del área usuaria mediante indicadores, reportes, minutas y planes de acción.
Coordinar la atención y el escalamiento de incidentes críticos, requerimientos operativos y cambios con impacto en el negocio.
Preparar y coordinar pruebas de aceptación de usuario, liberaciones, capacitación, comunicación, soporte inicial y transición a la operación.
Gestionar la relación operativa con proveedores, revisar planes y entregables, documentar acuerdos y validar el cumplimiento de compromisos y niveles de servicio.
Recopilar retroalimentación, indicadores de uso, resultados y lecciones aprendidas para identificar oportunidades de mejora continua.

LO QUE NECESITAS SABER (o HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS)
Licenciatura en Ingeniería Industrial, Sistemas, Tecnologías de la Información, Administración, Gestión de Proyectos o áreas afines.
Al menos 3 años de experiencia coordinando iniciativas de tecnología, integraciones, implementaciones de plataformas, mantenimiento o mejoras de aplicaciones.
Experiencia coordinando equipos multidisciplinarios mediante liderazgo transversal y gestión de stakeholders.
Conocimiento de gestión de proyectos, incluyendo alcance, cronograma, riesgos, calidad, presupuesto y beneficios.
Conocimiento de metodologías Agile, Waterfall e híbridas; son deseables fundamentos de ITIL, Scrum o Business Relationship Management.
Manejo de Jira, Confluence, Asana, MS Project o herramientas equivalentes para el seguimiento de proyectos.
Inglés avanzado para colaborar con equipos y stakeholders globales.

TÚ (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)
Planeas y organizas el trabajo con claridad, manteniendo seguimiento puntual de compromisos y entregables.
Lideras de forma transversal y construyes acuerdos entre equipos con prioridades diferentes.
Gestionas stakeholders con comunicación clara, oportuna y orientada a la acción.
Mantienes enfoque en el cliente y en el valor que las soluciones generan para las áreas usuarias.
Identificas riesgos, analizas problemas y promueves acciones de mitigación oportunas.
Trabajas con atención al detalle en requerimientos, documentación, pruebas y liberaciones.
Colaboras activamente con equipos internos, globales y proveedores para alcanzar objetivos compartidos.
Buscas retroalimentación y aprendizajes para impulsar la mejora continua.

VIDA EN TICKETMASTER
Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.
Como el mercado de boletos más grande del mundo y el proveedor global líder de herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una posición única para cumplir con esa visión.
Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.
Nuestra labor se guía por nuestros valores:

Fiabilidad
: Entendemos que los fanáticos y clientes dependen de nosotros para hacer posible sus experiencias en eventos en vivo, y nosotros dependemos los unos de los otros para lograrlo.
Trabajo
en
equipo
: Creemos que el logro individual es insignificante en comparación con el éxito que se puede lograr en equipo.
Integridad
: Estamos comprometidos con los más altos estándares morales y éticos en nombre de los innumerables socios y partes interesadas que representamos.
Sentido
de
pertenencia
: Estamos comprometidos a construir una cultura en la que todas las personas puedan ser su yo auténtico, tengan voz igualitaria y oportunidades para prosperar.

OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES
Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. Como negocio en crecimiento, fomentaremos que desarrolles tanto tus aspiraciones profesionales como personales, disfrutes de nuevas experiencias y aprendas de las personas talentosas con las que trabajarás. Nos importa el talento, y alentamos las postulaciones de personas sin importar su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, edad, estado de discapacidad o responsabilidades familiares.

PRÁCTICAS DE CONTRATACIÓN
La descripción del puesto anterior ha sido diseñada para indicar la naturaleza general y el nivel del trabajo realizado por los empleados dentro de esta clasificación. No está destinada a contener ni a interpretarse como un inventario exhaustivo de todas las funciones, responsabilidades y cualificaciones requeridas para los empleados asignados a este puesto.
Las políticas de contratación de Ticketmaster están diseñadas para incorporar a las personas más calificadas disponibles de manera oportuna y eficiente. Ticketmaster puede utilizar todos los medios disponibles, incluyendo la promoción interna, referencias de empleados, publicidad externa, agencias de empleo, reclutamiento por internet, ferias de empleo, reclutamiento universitario y head hunters. Ticketmaster puede utilizar herramientas de inteligencia artificial (IA) para apoyar la preselección y evaluación de candidaturas. Todas las decisiones de contratación se toman con revisión humana.

jobs.title: Senior ITS Project Manager
jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.

HDR is looking for a Senior ITS Project Manager to join our Transportation Business Group in either Charlotte or Raleigh. In the role of Senior ITS Project Manager, we'll count on you to:

Provide oversight and/or manage ITS and traffic management system projects including Planning, Engineering, Design, Integration, Deployment, Operations and Maintenance, Communications and overall Management.
Assist with the development of practice areas related to ITS program management and oversight, Transportation Systems Management and Operations (TSM&O), Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS), Transportation Management Centers (TMC), Advanced Traveler Information Systems (ATIS), Managed Lanes, Automated Connected Electric and Shared (ACES) vehicle technologies, and associated performance measures.
Develop Plans, Specifications and Estimates (PS&E) design packages, systems engineering analysis, ITS Architectures, and Concept of Operations
Design & implement National ITS Standards, Open Road Tolling, Active Traffic Management, communications systems, power distribution networks, lighting control, and traffic control equipment.
Participate in Automated Connected Electric and Shared (ACES) vehicle projects and emerging technology projects nationally.
Design and implement central/field communications, traffic control equipment, communications devices, traffic controller hardware and software, transit signal priority, CCTV cameras, DMS, traffic detectors, and electronic tolling equipment.
Assist with the development of local transportation program and serve as a technical expert nationally.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of large multidiscipline projects or medium-sized projects with high degree of technical complexity, typically involving a large project staff.
Establish client relations and be involved with marketing, contractual, design and production meetings.
Leverage work-share opportunities and coordinate workload with business class managers.
Implement QA/QC procedures and execute training for junior staff.
Perform other duties as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Engineering degree in Electrical or Civil
Experience working with multiple state DOTs/ regions on large, complex projects with strong project management background
Extensive experience in industry standards, including IEEE, NTCIP, MUTCD, NEMA, and NFPA standards
Leadership role in professional organizations, local candidates are preferred

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering
10 years related experience
A minimum 5 years project management experience
Requires professional engineering license recognized by the licensing board for the location of the position offered. Example: Professional Engineer (PE or P.Eng) license.
MS Office and MS Project experience (Access experience would be plus)
Demonstrated leadership, business development and strategic planning skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

If you are a Project Manager professional looking for an opportunity to grow, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you! Based in our Stafford, TX location, you will have the overall responsibility and authority for the implementation and execution of Customer projects. This includes having a complete understanding of the project scope and requirements while also having ownership for timely delivery and profitability.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Coordinate large, highly sophisticated and/or multinational projects.
Negotiate the initial scope of the project, change orders, terms and conditions and all additions or expansions to the project with the Local Business Partner/Sales Office, Global Industry Sales, and/or Customer.
Lead internal and external communication meetings to ensure alignment, including customer kickoff meetings, internal kickoff meetings, pre-inspection meetings, and close-out meetings.
Ensure the PO-to-Quote reconciliation is completed, which includes resolving all issues prior to PO Acceptance.
Develop and own the Project Plan that includes schedules, achievements, procurement strategy, execution strategy, financial targets, resources, communications, and considerations of risks by coordinating and managing activities from factory(s), logistics company(s), freight forwarder(s) and others as required to meet project requirements.
Ensure alignment with the Customer on the Emerson Commitment Date and the Customer PO Dates, including milestone dates for drawing and procedure submittals, drawing and procedure approvals, equipment inspection notifications, and “Ready for Inspection” dates.
Interface and continuously connect with the Impact Partner, Contractor, and/or Customer throughout the life of the project to provide updates, milestones, and progress. Serve as primary point of communication for Pressure Management.
Effectively provide leadership for a comprehensive project team consisting of project administration, order administration, engineering and factory project personnel who are responsible for implementing portions of the project.

Who You Are:

You quickly and decisively act in fact-changing, unpredictable situations. You adjust communication content and style to meet the needs of all team members. You create and implement plans that allocate resources precisely. You understand that different situations may call for different approaches. You find common ground and acceptable alternatives that satisfy the needs of multiple partners. You serve as a strategic partner to build, grow, and maintain profitable and long-lasting relationships with key accounts.

For This Role, You Will Need:

BA or BS Degree or equivalent experience
Experience related to Project Management
2+ years of direct Project Management experience; or 5+ years of Order Engineering, Customer Service, Applications Engineering, or Engineering experience in lieu of direct Project Management experience.

PMP

We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

Learn more about our Culture & Values .

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .

About Emerson

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.

We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!

Certifying Solution Designs and ensure platform customizations remain aligned with out-of-the-box (OOTB) best practices.

Facilitating pre- and post-go-live readiness, cutover support, and legacy platform sunsetting activities.

Validating and refine custom AI prompts, automated workflows, and seller productivity tools, establishing a structured handoff process to IT for long-term platform maintenance.

Coordinating end-user support, troubleshoot operational issues, and provide guidance across junior analysts and operations teams.

Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Experience as a Technical Business Analyst / Solution Provider in enterprise CRM environments.
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales (Dataverse, model-driven apps, security roles, forms/views, and custom entity design).
Experience in writing technical/business requirements, mapping specifications, user stories, and managing backlog refinement.
Experience leading complex, end-to-end CRM implementations across multi-sprint software development lifecycles (SDLC/Agile).
Willingness to travel (25% or less).

Even better if you have one or more of the following

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant Certifications (e.g., MB-210, PL-200, or PL-900).
Experience with UAT planning, test script creation, defect triage, and cutover/post go-live support.
Direct experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and Microsoft Copilot / AI features embedded in D365 Sales.
Expertise in prototyping low-code/no-code solutions and transferring operational builds to IT engineering teams.
Experience with complex data migrations, data validation testing (DVT), and third-party/legacy integration patterns (DMF, OData, REST APIs).
Background in telecom, enterprise B2B sales operations, or partner relationship management (PRM) workflows.
Self-directed with the ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and manage tight release deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

40

TL;DR
Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in Washington D.C. This role requires in-office attendance 4 days a week.

Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products.

With dotted-line leadership from the Director Research, the core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies and conduct risk-relevant research that contributes to the health of our data intelligence and overall platform.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

Responsibilities

Update existing research while monitoring developments on sanctions issues, regulatory environments, and other national security or compliance-related matters.
Identify and utilize new data and sources of information to develop subject matter expertise on strategic topics related to business intelligence research, conflict and illicit finance analysis, and banking sector risk management/compliance.
Identify risk-relevant research and data typologies, demonstrating sound analytical approaches and research techniques.
Demonstrate creativity, resourcefulness, and innovation while maintaining a high ethical standard in working with colleagues and leaders.

Qualifications

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field.
Language/Reading proficiency in one of the following languages: Russian, Arabic, Mandarin, Farsi or any other critical language.
At least 2+ years of SQL and/or Python experience, including experience with academic or professional research, as well as the use of databases and online, open source resources, is essential.
Understanding of global sanctions, international regulations, and compliance issues.
High ethical standard, cultural awareness, and sensitivity to work respectfully in a diverse research environment.

Benefits

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:

Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision
FSA program for both medical and dependent care
401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
Paid time off + 11 paid holidays

Job Title:
Program Manager, Trade Compliance
