Specific vision and hearing abilities may be required by this job, which include close vision and ability to adjust focus based on the task and surrounding activity. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The ability for the use of tools (such as: powered hand tools and other types of tools, including but not limited to combustion appliances, machinery and motors that have moving parts, belts, pulleys, elevators, motors, pumps and/or fans) may be required. Equipment for working at height (such as: ladders, mechanical lifts, etc.,) may be required to be used. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Serve as the primary advocate for project success and Mainspring Energy’s lead field representative, coordinating cross-functionally with engineering, logistics, manufacturing, commissioning, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful delivery throughout the full project lifecycle

Lead concurrent turnkey power generation projects, as well as oversee multiple third party developed equipment sale projects, from development through commissioning and closeout

Job Description

The Senior Healthcare Business and Quality Analyst is the primary requirements and domain-analysis partner for Quality Engineering. The role translates product intent, healthcare operations, regulations, and data behavior into clear, testable requirements and serves as a subject-matter reference for QA. Its emphasis is business analysis and domain accuracy rather than test execution ownership.

Monitor healthcare policy, contractual, and operational changes; perform impact analysis and advise teams on affected workflows, data, and validation needs.

Demonstrated ability to create precise requirements, acceptance criteria, process models, business rules, and traceability artifacts in Agile delivery environments.
Strong knowledge of at least two healthcare domains, such as claims, eligibility and enrollment, benefits, provider, clinical, utilization management, pharmacy, or payment integrity.

Excellent facilitation, critical thinking, negotiation, documentation, and executive-ready communication skills.

Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products.

With dotted-line leadership from the Director Research, the core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies and conduct risk-relevant research that contributes to the health of our data intelligence and overall platform.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. Identify and utilize new data and sources of information to develop subject matter expertise on strategic topics related to business intelligence research, conflict and illicit finance analysis, and banking sector risk management/compliance.
Identify risk-relevant research and data typologies, demonstrating sound analytical approaches and research techniques.
Demonstrate creativity, resourcefulness, and innovation while maintaining a high ethical standard in working with colleagues and leaders.

Language/Reading proficiency in one of the following languages: Russian, Arabic, Mandarin, Farsi or any other critical language.
At least 2+ years of SQL and/or Python experience, including experience with academic or professional research, as well as the use of databases and online, open source resources, is essential.
Understanding of global sanctions, international regulations, and compliance issues.
High ethical standard, cultural awareness, and sensitivity to work respectfully in a diverse research environment.

Job Overview

A key enabler of Mainspring’s mission is the ability of its team to deliver solutions based on our linear generator technology that solve customer problems in the cross-section of resiliency and clean power generation.   This includes site due diligence, design engineering, permitting, construction operations, and commissioning.

Responsibilities
A Senior Project Manager will:

Drive a culture of safety, quality and best practices on all aspects of the Project

Oversee and manage the development and construction of Company projects. Scope, schedule, cost management in accordance with project and stakeholder requirements

new_jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager - Hybrid (Los Angeles)
new_jobs.description:
XPRIZE Overview

XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. As a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. Since our founding in 1994, we’ve launched $519 million in prize competitions that are driving more than $31 billion in social and economic impact — a 60x return on philanthropic investment. These competitions not only de-risk early-stage breakthrough ideas but also mobilize capital, talent, and momentum to accelerate solutions from concept to real-world scale.

We operate across 5 areas of impact, including:

Deep Tech + Exploration
Energy + Climate + Nature
Food + Water + Waste
Health
Learning + Society

Join XPRIZE to help create meaningful impact as we strive to empower humanity to achieve breakthroughs and architect a more equitable and abundant future for all.

Position Description

We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to develop and manage comprehensive marketing campaigns for key initiatives and programs within the organization. This person will work closely with the Marketing and Prize Operations teams to plan, develop, activate, and manage marketing activities to drive awareness and engagement with key audiences. This role serves as the primary marketing point of contact for Prize Operations teams and is a pivotal role for the success of XPRIZE competitions.

Responsibilities

Marketing Campaign Strategy: Partner with other marketing and Prize Operations teams to develop integrated campaigns that build awareness and engagement for prizes, programs, and the foundation. Define measurable objectives, target audience, and associated calls to action for each campaign; and provide regular reporting to stakeholders tracking progress and performance against objectives.
Stakeholder Management: Build and nurture relationships with internal and external stakeholders across programs, including prize/program teams, sponsors, partners, judges, and advisors. Navigate competing stakeholder priorities to ensure that marketing campaigns are aligned with prize objectives and business priorities. Provide marketing-specific prize and program updates to stakeholders.
Project Management: Leverage project management skills and the PM tool of record to ensure that event and campaign deliverables are completed in a timely manner, and all stakeholders are updated on progress, risks, and challenges.
Communications: In partnership with the Communications and Creative teams, contribute to the development of key messaging for programs and prize-related content, as well as communications resources for external stakeholders.
Events: In partnership with the Experiential team, contribute to the planning and execution of events to support campaign objectives. Develop marketing materials to support foundation, program, and prize milestone events. Collaborate with Prize Operations teams to develop materials to support XPRIZE presence at industry conferences and events.
Budgeting and Resource Management: Support the development and management of prize marketing budgets, including classifying actuals and tracking actuals against budget and forecast.
Marketing Technology: Leverage marketing-specific tools and technology to manage marketing campaigns and associated projects; measure campaign performance; develop and refine target audiences; and gather social media insights.
Trendspotting: Stay up-to-date on prize/program-related news and industry trends, proactively identifying opportunities to incorporate trends into active and upcoming campaigns.

Qualifications

5+ years of proven experience developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that unify messaging across a variety of channels
4-year college or university degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms
The ability to combine technical/scientific information with emotion to form a compelling message across multiple audiences
Experience in developing cross-channel marketing campaigns consisting of clear, measurable objectives, well-defined target audience(s), and associated calls to action
Experience monitoring campaign performance, gathering data insights, and preparing reports to evaluate campaign efficiency, proposing changes to optimize campaigns as needed
Strong organizational and project management skills to handle multiple tasks, manage campaigns from development to launch, and ensure timely delivery of campaign deliverables
Experience with creating and managing budgets, including budget tracking and reporting
Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive collaboration across teams to maximize impact and drive business results
Exceptional interpersonal skills, including the ability to influence without authority, manage competing priorities, address concerns, and work closely and collaboratively with colleagues and staff
Passion for the mission of XPRIZE and the work we are doing to build a better future
Having a growth mindset and a passion for continuous improvement is essential

Why Work at XPRIZE:

In addition to working for a mission-driven company that catalyzes industries, pushes innovation forward, and is creating an abundant and equitable future, we offer the following benefits:

Remote-first environment (must live and work in the United States)
Quarterly company-paid All-Hands meetings in Los Angeles for frequent in-person collaboration
Employee and dependent medical, dental, and vision options
A 401(K) program with employer match
Ample paid time off, including vacation, floating holidays, sick days, and company-paid holidays
An Employee Assistance Program for confidential, professional support with personal, family, or other challenges
Employee stipends/reimbursements for cell phone, internet, health & wellbeing, and learning & development
Generous Paid Parental Leave for all employees welcoming a new child to their family
One meeting-free block per week and four focus weeks per year to ensure uninterrupted time for strategic projects

The anticipated base salary for this position is $90,000 to $115,000 and may also qualify for an annual incentive. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors including the qualifications of the individual applicant, years of relevant experience for the role, level of education attained, and certifications and/or other licenses held. XPRIZE is a remote-first environment. All employees must be authorized to work in the United States and work from within the United States full-time.

The XPRIZE FOUNDATION is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate in employment. Equal access to employment, services, and programs is available to all persons. Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a representative of the organization.

You are not considered an applicant until you have been contacted directly by a Talent Acquisition representative requesting that you begin the designated application process, which may involve phone and/or in-person interview(s), job-related testing, and background checks.
